limitations: The 28 database entries include 7 locations without questIDs; those entries have no quest prerequisites to audit.
The current dungeon-preparation policy excludes repeatable quests from automatic collection. The recorded prerequisite alternatives for quests 7429 and 7483–7485 do not change that policy.
Quest 2340/2341 and 4001/4002 have known prerequisite edges but no captured pickup/turn-in map stages in the shipped catalogue. Their chain facts are retained; no locations were invented.
The shipped Dungeon Journal records dungeon maps, encounters, and quest map markers; it does not provide a prerequisite graph.

Community comments were checked on the candidate Wailing Caverns and Dire Maul pages where relevant. They support the Altered Beings link and the faction alternatives for the three libram quests. No matching comment evidence was found for quest 7429, so that link remains supported only by structured QuestieDB data. Comment IDs and factual assessments are retained; comment prose is not copied.
